review_findings.r80_gate: Requires the canonical Git-bound R80 profile, tracked validated census record and bound raw report/rows/pair proofs/query and validation producers, exact watcher receipt, idle 5000-valid/zero-pending action, and a separate R81 dataset root.
review_findings.runtime_gate: Requires a Git ancestor commit, exact Git blob hashes and a clean worktree match for all antenna Python sources plus the entry, worker, exploration, validation, simulator support, and profile config sources.
review_findings.engineering_gate: Requires exactly one 6-row Fast, one 2-row Discrete, and one 2-row mesh job and recomputes all four saved comparisons with both maximum curve and margin differences at most 0.3 dB before Formal.
review_findings.formal_gate: Accepts only a nonempty contiguous b1..bN prefix for N in 1..3; b1 is 20 history/20 specialist/20 random, while b2 and b3 are 20 best_min_margin/20 uncertainty/20 random and bind prior audited feedback, completed trained ensemble, and exact model hash.
review_findings.repeat_gate: Allows zero or more explicit repeats; each repeat binds a completed positive original under the same R81 measurement and score profile and does not gate ordinary formal jobs.
review_findings.queue_gate: Binds exact native jobs.json ordering, native <input>/config.yaml fields, all direct input bytes, fixed retry roster, and rejects machine-pinned jobs.
review_findings.worker_state_gate: A per-worker fail stays active; terminal failure requires every released job to be done or to have an exact roster-exhausted native claim/fail chain. A done marker requires its matching claim and a physically complete store identical to the released input metadata.
review_findings.launcher: Revalidates the immutable release and semantic queue state before each --once claim and invokes only dedust worker with the fixed scope, selfgen 0, poll 60, and stale 120 arguments. It contains no jobs-add or git-pull path.

adoption_requirements: Commit the three frozen files, then build any release against that actual commit so the Git-blob gate is exercised without the test-only post-commit monkeypatch.
Create and independently review an actual immutable release only after R80 records exact 5000 valid unique and zero pending; no such completion or R81 release exists in this review.

Serialize each queue-prefix transition: let launchers for the current immutable prefix reach all_success and exit before appending and launching the next reviewed prefix. The read-only preflight and dedust claim are consecutive but do not share an atomic queue lock.
Re-run the existing engineering and formal gates on actual R81 artifacts; the saved test evidence is synthetic and does not establish HFSS behavior, scientific performance, or a positive candidate.

evidence.scope: Static review of only the frozen v1-to-v2 R80 evidence portability binding delta; no test, training, launcher, worker, queue, NAS, or HFSS execution.

reviewed_delta.archived_action: Requires archive path, archive SHA-256, and an absolute producer_path. The bound watcher last_receipt is compared with producer_path while last_receipt_sha256 is compared with the archived action bytes.
reviewed_delta.archived_profile: Requires archive path, archive SHA-256, and an absolute producer_path. Watch and action embedded profile paths are compared with producer_path; their profile hashes are compared with the archived bytes. The archived profile is parsed and required to equal the current canonical profile whose source bytes are already covered by the Git-clean runtime binding.
reviewed_delta.tracked_census: Requires exactly repo_path and SHA-256. repo_path must be a safe repository-relative docs/log/assets/r80_*.json path. The resolved file must match the selected release commit Git blob and remain clean in the current clone before its JSON is consumed.
reviewed_delta.unchanged_launcher: The PowerShell launcher hash is unchanged from the independently reviewed v1 candidate.

test_evidence_not_rerun.reason: The bounded v2 request explicitly prohibited rerunning the full suite and opt-in training; this review inspected only the exact frozen portability delta.

conclusions: Archive-location portability no longer breaks authentic original-path comparisons.
The copied action and profile cannot substitute their archive paths for the producer paths recorded by R80.
A machine-specific absolute census path is rejected; the tracked status record resolves correctly in each clone.

Allowing byte-different archived YAML is intentional and bounded to profiles that parse identically to the Git-clean canonical runtime profile; archive bytes remain independently SHA-bound to watch and action metadata.
No new blocker was found in the reviewed delta.
inherited_limits_and_adoption_requiremen: The v1 independent review remains preserved separately and supplied the focused 17-test lifecycle evidence; this v2 review does not repeat it.
